why: Mutations whose Negative subjects rows are incomplete: each fails these ids, outside its row, for a real coupling the row does not name (the slice 4c preflight, M6). Applier 0.14 left these rows as they were, so they stand; they go when a later revision completes the rows, with GA-TOKEN-4's rewording and slice 4b's two rows. Each was seen on slice 4b's head too, but reissues-on-timeout's: applier 0.14's GA-DESC-18 forbids reissuing a step not idempotent when it was dispatched, which a blind reissue breaks, and its row names GA-APPLY-6 alone; and fresh-by-arrival's GA-EVT-8, whose harness test needs a silent sensor to go stale before an occurrence, which freshness by arrival never lets it. Slice 6a adds keeps-a-tier-below-a-new-load's GA-DESC-8: on a subject claiming Safe a socket with no load configured is heating, and GA-DESC-8's test checks that its turn_on is above reversible, which a tier blind to the load breaks; the row names GA-DESC-13 and GA-DESC-3 only. It also adds plans-through-broker-loss's GA-SAFE-11: its harness test severs the applier's broker link to have a held report delivered again, and waits for the sensor to read dead first, as GA-BUS-6's does, which liveness kept through a broker loss breaks. Slice 6b adds four, each a coupling its harness test cannot avoid: ignores-owner-bound's GA-SAFE-10, whose notice for an owner's fresh_s longer than the declared one needs the owner's bound, which the mutation ignores; reissues-on-timeout's GA-SAFE-12, whose test checks that a not-idempotent turn_off nothing answers is sent once, which a blind reissue sends again (its row names GA-SAFE-5 for the same act, not GA-SAFE-12's re-send clause); plans-on-a-stale-declaration's GA-SAFE-13, whose rule is disabled on a change of the heater's declarations, which the mutation takes as no model change; and resends-what-may-have-run's GA-SAFE-3 and GA-SAFE-8, whose tests need a pump's not-idempotent turn_off to end failed(no_ack), which the mutation sends again and the simulated pump then acks (its row names GA-SAFE-5 and GA-SAFE-12). Slice 6c adds two, each a coupling GA-LOAD-2's harness test cannot avoid: reissues-on-timeout's, whose test checks that the pulse relay's cap turn-off, declared idempotent: false and answered by nothing, is sent once, which a blind reissue of the applier's own actuation sends again (as its GA-SAFE-12); and never-fails-a-silent-ack's, whose test needs that turn-off to end failed(no_ack) so its load_cap notice is raised, which the mutation never ends. Slice 7a adds never-fails-a-silent-ack's GA-PERSIST-1: its harness test checks that a step waiting for its ack ends failed(no_ack) at the bound it kept across the restart, which the mutation never ends. Slice 7b adds trusts-retained-online's GA-SAFE-12: its harness test keeps a close waiting on a valve its bridge reports unavailable across a restart, and at the start the mutation takes the bridge's retained status as live, so the valve reads live, and is sent the close, until its own retained status, delivered after the bridge's on the one subscription, says it is gone; which comes first is the broker's timing, so the coupling shows only at times. It also adds gives-up-on-dead's GA-SAFE-1: its harness test has a wet report made while the applier was down fire the rule on the applier's return, when every device reads dead until its bridge is heard live (a start is the broker's loss, the maintainer's ruling 4), so the close waits for the valve, which the mutation gives up on; a retained report is delivered on subscribing, before any live status, so no test can deliver it to a valve already live. Slice 5b adds trusts-retained-online's GA-DISC-2: its harness test has a second bridge of the type that was never live, dead only because the applier hears nothing from it but its retained status, which the mutation takes as live, so the candidate's offer names both bridges. Before slice 5b the coupling hid: the revival on a retained status delivered before its SUBACK was undone by the listening that followed, which the mutation no longer does. The applier 0.16 build adds two: replaces-without-rules's GA-DESC-11, whose clause that a tier the owner raised is kept across a replacement needs the old device's declarations, which the mutation drops (its row names GA-ADOPT-2 only); and merges-a-claimant's GA-EVT-1, whose step over a new route routes and adopts a device the second bridge also reports, which needs GA-BUS-11's fold, which the mutation's site turns off for every device, not only an adopted id's claimant (its row names GA-ADOPT-1 only).
